'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Israel–Hezbollah conflict (2023–present)|Israel–Hezbollah conflict]]
**[[September 2024 Lebanon strikes]]
***Over 492 people are killed and 1,645 others are injured when the [[Israeli Air Force]] conducts over 1,400 [[airstrike]]s in [[Lebanon]] targeting [[Hezbollah]], the deadliest day of conflict since the [[2006 Lebanon War]]. [https://www.nytimes.com/live/2024/09/23/world/gaza-israel-hamas-hezbollah/here-are-the-latest-developments (''New York Times'')] [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/9/23/israel-warns-lebanon-civilians-of-air-strikes-on-hezbollah7 (Al Jazeera)] [https://apnews.com/article/israel-palestinians-hamas-war-news-lebanon-hezbollah-e3ca9c83642056f962fdf76319e3b8de (AP)]
***Hezbollah launches dozens of [[rocket]]s and [[Loitering munition|drone]]s at [[Israel]] in retaliation for the airstrikes. [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/israel-lebanon-hezbollah-war-gaza-hamas-idf-airstrikes/ (CBS News)]
***The [[United Nations Interim Force in Lebanon]] advises all posted civilian employees to evacuate [[southern Lebanon]]. [https://www.jpost.com/breaking-news/article-821337 (''The Jerusalem Post'')]
***The [[Israel Defense Forces|Israeli military]] advises [[Lebanese people|Lebanese]] civilians in southern Lebanon to evacuate north. [https://apnews.com/article/israel-palestinians-hamas-war-news-lebanon-hezbollah-e3ca9c83642056f962fdf76319e3b8de (AP)]
**The [[United States]] deploys additional [[United States Armed Forces|military forces]] to the [[Middle East]] following significantly escalating conflict between Israel and Hezbollah and a potential wider regional conflict, adding to the 40,000 U.S. troops already present in the region. [https://apnews.com/article/israel-lebanon-violence-war-hezbollah-63a15fa390a94acf46ef886cc5fb88db (AP)]
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[2024 Kursk offensive]]
***The [[Ministry of Foreign Affairs (Russia)|Russian Foreign Ministry]] reports that at least 56 [[Russians|Russian civilians]] were killed and 266 others were injured by the [[Armed Forces of Ukraine]] in [[Kursk Oblast]], [[Russia]], which the [[Ministry of Foreign Affairs (Ukraine)|Ukrainian Foreign Ministry]] denies as [[State propaganda in the Russian Federation|Russian propaganda]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russia-says-31-civilians-killed-during-ukrainian-offensive-kursk-region-2024-09-23/ (Reuters)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[2023–2024 mpox epidemic]]
**The [[World Health Organization]] announces that nearly 30,000 suspected [[mpox]] cases have been reported in [[Africa]] so far this year, primarily in the [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]], as the death toll from mpox surpasses 800 people. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/almost-30000-suspected-mpox-cases-africa-this-year-who-says-2024-09-23/ (Reuters)]
*[[Deforestation of the Amazon rainforest]]
**[[Climatology|Climate researchers]] report that since 1985, [[deforestation]] in the [[Amazon rainforest|Amazon]] has caused the loss of an area of [[rainforest]] equal to the combined area of [[France]] and [[Germany]]. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20240923-amazon-forest-loses-area-the-size-of-germany-and-france-fueling-fires (France 24)]
